newsitem.title: JORDAN: Transport hopes drive Jordan shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Transport hopes drive Jordan shares higher.

text.p: Shares on the Jordan stock exchange rose 0.30 percent on Monday, boosted by strong gains in transport stock expected to benefit from goods flowing through Jordan into Iraq, brokers said.
The Amman Financial Market 60-share index rose 0.46 points to 152.78 points in business worth 709,000 dinars ($1 million).
Busy trade in transport firm Unified Co, which rose 0.10 dinars to 2.14 dinars in turnover of 159,000 dinars, gave the market upward momentum after a week of falling prices.
"Brokers are still focused on the industrial and transport companie which are expected to do well out of Iraq's food-for-oil deal," said analyst Mohammad Abdullah of Pearl Consulting.
Other strong gainers on Monday were Jordan Selpho Chemicals which rose 0.04 dinars to 0.84 dinars and National Industrial, which rose 0.03 dinars to 0.68 dinars.
Overall 25 shares rose, seven fell, and 12 traded but closed unchanged. Monday's trade was about one third of recent levels, boosted on Sunday by bloc trades in banking firms.
"Most of the buying today was small local investors, with some institutional buying," Abdullah said.
The private Pearl Index of 45 best-traded shares rose 0.54 percent to 82.86 points, still 13.25 percent down on last year.
